prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a clean modern 1:1 fashion sale advertisement on a light-gray studio background. Feature one adult woman matching the authorized identity reference, with a curvy feminine silhouette, natural makeup, long straight dark hair, and a calm confident expression looking directly at camera. She wears a black baseball cap, oversized green T-shirt, black shorts, white mid-calf socks, and chunky white sneakers with black sole details. Seat her on the floor in a relaxed pose, slightly leaning forward, one knee bent upward and the other leg extended outward, one hand near her chin and the other touching the shoe. Place very large semi-transparent white SALE text behind her. Add large bold center text 20% OFF, below it on orders above ₹990, a small white label reading USE CODE AUQIB10 with the code in red, and a thin white outlined SHOP NOW button at bottom center. Use soft studio lighting, high-resolution photorealistic detail, accurate legible typography, and no extra text or logos.
